## Description {#details}

<p>Combine VALU pairs into VOPD instructions Only works on wave32 Has register requirements, we reject creating VOPD if the requirements are not met.</p>


<p>shouldCombineVOPD mutator in postRA machine scheduler puts candidate instructions for VOPD back-to-back</p>
